title: Orchestrator dispatcher↔worker handoff (v1)
description: Versioned structured-data handoff contract. Bundles two definitions: handoff_envelope (dispatcher→worker, outbound) and task_result (worker→daemon, inbound). T2 enforces task_result at /overlay/status terminal validation; T3 hands handoff_envelope to the Agent-tool `schema` option at dispatch. Slotted fields replace prose so a worker COPIES values instead of parsing a prompt.

handoff_envelope.title: handoff_envelope
handoff_envelope.description: Outbound: what a dispatcher hands a worker subagent at dispatch. Plugs into the Agent-tool `schema` option (T3). The worker copies slotted fields verbatim into its graph duties instead of re-deriving them from prose.

version.description: Schema major version. Const so consumers can reject mismatched envelopes.

task_key.description: Graph task key the worker claims (start_task / branch_task).

agent_id.description: Stable worker agent id used on start_task and complete_task.

branch.description: Isolated attempt branch (orch/attempt/<key>). All worker writes happen here.

target_repo.description: Absolute path of the repo the worktree lives in (configure_task repo_path or the workspace).

files_in_scope.description: Files the worker is expected to touch. Advisory scope hint, not a hard fence.

plan_goal.description: One-sentence objective of the overall plan this task belongs to. Gives the worker the 'why' behind their scoped work — the broader initiative the dispatcher decomposed.

task_key.description: Graph task key of the sibling.

title.description: Short task title — enough to know what the sibling covers.

sibling_tasks.description: Lightweight list of sibling tasks in the same plan (key + title only). Workers can call get_task_detail on a specific sibling if they need deeper context or want to check its status.

task_key.description: Source task/note key the summary came from.

summary.description: Pre-resolved Tier-1 note/dependency summary — dispatcher resolves it so the worker need not query.

context_deps.description: Pre-resolved Tier-1 context (dependency + note summaries) the dispatcher already fetched, so the worker starts with base context inline.

agentic_search_context.description: Optional Subconscious-owned filtered context envelope. Dispatchers copy this from subconscious_assignment/search-context instead of exposing raw search_knowledge results to workers.

return_contract.description: The shape the worker must return. Reference to task_result so envelope and result stay coupled to one version.

agentic_search_context.title: agentic_search_context
agentic_search_context.description: Filtered context returned by Subconscious after an internal budgeted DAG/RAG follow-up loop and relevance judgment.

task_result.title: task_result
task_result.description: Inbound: what a worker returns via complete_task → POST /overlay/status terminal write. T2 will enforce this at terminal validation. metric_measurements is required ONLY when the task carries a metric spec (see allOf conditional).

status.description: Terminal outcome the worker reports. tested = work done and verified; failed = could not complete.

summary.description: Concise interface summary other tasks pull as cheap Tier-1 base context.

files_changed.description: Files the worker actually modified/created (paths relative to target_repo).

tests_run.description: What was run to verify (command(s) and outcome). Free text — the evidence behind `status`.

wires_to.description: Provenance edges — task keys this note wires to (always includes the current task_key).

decisions.description: Durable decisions/findings the worker captured mid-task, with their provenance wiring.

metric_measurements.description: Measured metric output. REQUIRED only when the task carries a metric spec. Mirrors overlay measurement shape: { value, guardrails }.

guardrails.description: Guardrail metric → measured value, keyed by guardrail metric name.

has_metric_spec.description: Validation-time discriminator T2 injects from overlay.metrics[key] before validating; drives the metric_measurements conditional below. Not persisted as part of the result.

allOf.$comment: Conditional: when the task carries a metric spec, T2 sets has_metric_spec=true before validation and metric_measurements becomes required.
